body.p: Meeting of a wild reindeer with a sturgeon (legend). It happened a long time ago. One day, a wild reindeer bull descended from the rocky side onto the bank of the Yenisey. The wild reindeer bull is thinking of crossing the Yenisey. And so he swam across the water of the Yenisey. In the middle of the Yenisey, he came across an underwater island. The wild reindeer bull climbed onto this island for a rest. Suddenly a big sturgeon appeared from under the water in front of him. The wild reindeer got very happy about this meeting and said. I've been looking for you for a long time. What for? The sturgeon said. It's good if our meeting goes well. In what way? When we reindeer eat moss in winter, it goes bad. We need cartilages for our noses. And you have a lot of that. Then let's change, said the sturgeon, we also have something we need. What? We sturgeons need meat. When we swim in deep [ShA:] My interpretation water, it is necessary for heavy weight. Then what's the matter? Let's change.of ÑÑÐ¹Ò«Ð¸Ð´Ð¾ is unsure. I'll give you meat, and you give me a cartilage. Well, that's fine. The sturgeon gave the reindeer a cartilage from his head, and the deer gave him a piece of meat. Henceforth, there is such a legend. Until that time, reindeer had no cartilage in their noses, and sturgeons had no meat on their cheeks. After this, the reindeer got a cartilage in their noses, and the sturgeons got meat on their cheeks. The meeting place of the wild deer and the sturgeon is now called Chervinsky Island. Previously, in the 80s, before our years, this island was called as follows, a Nenets shaman lived there, his name was Yelka, and the island was also called Yelka. By now, there are still images of the idols of the shaman Yelka on the rocky side of the Yenisey.
